name: Volumetric TPMS
description: A triply periodic minimal surface, thickened into a printable solid.

inputParameters.name: type
inputParameters.description: Gyroid, SchwarzP, Diamond, Neovius, Lidinoid, FischerKoch or IWP. Defaults to Gyroid.

inputParameters.name: cell
inputParameters.description: Cell size, the true period of the pattern.

inputParameters.name: mode
inputParameters.description: "sheet" thickens the surface; "network" fills one channel. Defaults to sheet.

inputParameters.name: plane
inputParameters.description: Orients and positions the lattice. Defaults to world XY.

outputParameters.name: vol
outputParameters.description: A volumetric object, to combine or to mesh.
